views.title: Vehicle Motion Cues Backport for iOS 15 & 16

views.markdown:
**DePuke** is a lightweight, battery-conscious rootless iOS tweak that backports iOS 18's **Vehicle Motion Cues** to **iOS 15.0 – 16.5+** using real-time `CoreMotion` accelerometer and gyroscope sensor fusion.

### How It Works
Motion sickness in vehicles happens when your eyes focus on a stationary screen while your inner ear senses linear acceleration, braking, and turns. **DePuke** renders smooth, non-intrusive peripheral motion dots along the edges of your screen that react in real time to vehicle inertial forces—resolving sensory conflict without blocking touch input or UI interaction.

### Key Features
- **Real-Time CoreMotion Signal Processing:** Low-pass filtered inertial acceleration & angular velocity fusion for natural, jitter-free dot motion.
- **System-Wide Touch-Passthrough Overlay:** Works seamlessly across all apps while passing 100% of touches through to the underlying interface.
- **Rootless Native (`arm64` / `arm64e`):** Built for **Dopamine** and **Palera1n** rootless jailbreaks.
- **100% Free & Open-Source:** Released freely for the jailbreak community.

- Refined `CoreMotion` inertial smoothing and peripheral dot responsiveness.
- Improved rootless preferences persistence and low-power idle handling.
